capabilities: Expand DNT expressions in existing daily notes
Evaluate expressions relative to the note's parsed date
Detect daily-note paths via Daily notes settings
Support repeating date fields in path formats
disambiguation: Not a daily-notes creator or template applier; it only expands DNT expressions in notes that already exist.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README specifies sync-safe behavior: it never waits on Obsidian Sync and uses atomic vault processing so concurrent edits are preserved.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's Daily notes and Templates plugins remain responsible for creating notes and applying the normal note template.
problem: Daily-note templates are static, so expressions in a note cannot reference the specific date the note belongs to.

relations.evidence: It uses Obsidian's Daily notes settings to identify daily-note paths.
Obsidian's Daily notes and Templates plugins remain responsible for creating notes and applying the normal note template.

summary: Date-aware template expander that fills <% dnt %> expressions in existing daily notes, evaluated against the date parsed from the note path.
